Declare
 v_temp number;

Begin

/* Depending upon the entry, ISBT or CODABAR will be decided in the query program */

 Else

 End if;

 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_id is not null then

 select nvl(count(*),0) into v_temp from donations where unit_id=szUnitId;

 if v_temp=0 then
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 END IF;

Exception
 when others then 
 Handle_error;

end;

PROCEDURE do_inter_retrieve IS
 cursor inter_cur is Select a.inter_code,b.inter_desc from valid_regint_reasons a,
 valid_interdictions b where substr(a.inter_reason,1,4)=:ctrl_blk_1.s_group_id and
 a.inter_code=b.inter_code order by 1;

End if;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_unit_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :donations.dummy_unit_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_chapter_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :global.chapter_id); 
/* Modified and verified for Y2k......Sobha.......06/07/1999 */
 if p_window_name='DRWHOLDS' then

 end if;

END;
